newMessages.content: For the second movement, you previously mentioned wanting the strings to carry the primary melodic line while winds provide harmonic support.

Actually I've been rethinking the Klangfarbenmelodie approach. Instead of giving the tune to the violins alone, what if I fragment the Hauptstimme across oboe, clarinet, and flute in two-bar segments? The Nebenstimmen would stay in the low brass. It creates that pointillistic Webern quality but within a more Romantic Satz.
